profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer| AWS Cloud | Agile | Software Engineering | xNASA | Building Innovative Software Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m a former NASA technical lead and cloud engineer with a track record of designing and delivering secure, scalable software systems across both public and private sectors. Over the past 8+ years, I’ve led cross-functional teams to build enterprise AWS cloud platforms, architect software systems, and implement Agile practices at scale.

At NASA, I oversaw data infrastructure efforts for SBIR programs, developed internal tools used across the agency, and led business intelligence due diligence systems tied to federal mandates. I’ve architected cost-saving ML-enabled solutions and collaborated with AWS SA teams to deliver long-term value.

Beyond code, I mentor, roadmap, hire, and pitch. I enjoy driving MVPs from zero to one, scaling teams, and working across disciplines to get real outcomes fast.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Software Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Led cloud architecture and ML integration for mission-critical data systems across SBIR and broader NASA programs.
- Built internal tools that enabled agency-wide due diligence for federal compliance (SBIR/STTR Extension Act of 2022).
- Designed, procured, and deployed a AWS system that delivered business intelligence insights while reducing infrastructure costs.
- Oversaw Agile team operations using SAFe and Scrum methodologies; served as Product Owner and Scrum Master.
- Reviewed and approved full software lifecycle phases (design, development, test, release) for internal + COTS solutions.

skills.name: Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Serverless Architecture
Leadership & Management: Hiring, Team Building, Roadmapping, Cross-functional Collaboration
Languages & Tools: Python, JavaScript, SQL, Git, JIRA, Confluence
Other: Data Governance, ML System Design, SBIR/STTR Due Diligence
